name: Ahead of It
intro: You will build a short list of things that cost you if you forget them (from the ready-made list), mark one done and undo it, type a made-up amount of money on hand, and write a note on how you handle your taxes. Only use the example words and numbers — nothing real.

steps.do: Look at the welcome card at the bottom (“Welcome to Ahead of It”). Tap the small words “skip the tour” at its bottom right.
steps.see: A card asks “How do you want to start?” with two choices: “🧪 Keep the examples to play with” and “✨ Start fresh with my own”.
steps.tip: A green greeting strip may also show at the top (for example “Good morning.”). Tap its ✕ if it is in the way. Testing again on a phone that has used Ahead of It before? The welcome card may not show. If you already see the menu with four big buttons (step 3) or the main page, tick steps 1–3 ✅ and carry on.

steps.do: Tap “✨ Start fresh with my own”.
steps.see: The card goes away (a brand-new phone has nothing to clear, so it may not ask). If a small box does ask “Start fresh? The examples will be cleared.”, tap OK.

steps.do: Wait a moment (2–4 seconds).
steps.see: A menu fills the screen: a greeting, “What would you like to do?”, and four big buttons — “What’s coming due”, “Add a bill or renewal”, “How’s this month’s money?” and “🎬 Watch how it works”.

steps.do: Tap “What’s coming due”.
steps.see: The main page. Under “OVERDUE” it says “Nothing overdue. That is the whole point.” and near the top there is a gold button “⚡ Quick setup — tick what’s yours”.

steps.do: Tap the gold “⚡ Quick setup — tick what’s yours”.
steps.see: A “⚡ Quick setup” screen opens with groups like TAXES, HOME and VEHICLES. Each line has a tick box on the left and a date on the right.

steps.do: Under TAXES, tap “Income tax return”.
steps.see: Its box gets a gold tick ✓.

steps.do: Scroll down to PETS and tap “Dog / cat vaccines + license”.
steps.see: Its box gets a gold tick ✓ too.

steps.do: Scroll ALL the way to the bottom and tap “Save my list — however many that is”.
steps.see: A box says “2 items on your list, with dates. That’s a real start. 🌿” Tap OK. Back on the main page, under “LATER”, you see “Income tax return” (Apr 15) and “Dog / cat vaccines + license” (May 1), each with a green “done ✓” button.
steps.tip: Until you reach the very bottom, the purple test-copy bar covers this button. Keep scrolling and it rises above the bar.

steps.do: Tap the green “done ✓” next to “Income tax return”.
steps.see: A green note at the top says “Income tax return — done ✓. Next one: … Apr 15. It has moved down the list to its new date.” with an “↩ Undo” button. Income tax return is now below the dog vaccines.

steps.do: Quickly tap “↩ Undo” in that green note.
steps.see: A short note says “Put back — nothing changed” and Income tax return is back at the top of the list.

steps.do: Tap “💰 Type what's on hand”. In the box that asks “What is on hand right now — checking plus cash, roughly?”, type this number and tap OK.
steps.see: The money card now says “Covered — $1,250 on hand leaves $1,250 after the bills” and the button has changed to “💰 Update what's on hand”.

steps.do: Tap “💰 Update what's on hand” again, delete the number so the box is empty, and tap OK.
steps.see: The amount is cleared: the money card goes back to “💰 Type what's on hand” and the $1,250 line is gone.

steps.do: Tap the pill near the top that says “🌱 Level 1 · Just what is next   change ›”.
steps.see: A card asks “How much do you want on the screen?” with three levels: 🌱 Level 1, 🌿 Level 2 and 🌳 Level 3.

steps.do: Tap “🌿 Level 2 · The year and the library”.
steps.see: The card closes, a short note says “Level 2 — The year and the library. New things are on the screen now.”, and each item now has a “📘 How” button.

steps.do: Turn on Airplane Mode (swipe down from the top-right corner, tap ✈️). Then tap “done ✓” next to “Dog / cat vaccines + license”.
steps.see: It still works with no internet: a green note says “Dog / cat vaccines + license — done ✓. Next one: … May 1 …” and the dog vaccines line now shows a date a year further out.

steps.do: Turn Airplane Mode off. Then pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: The page comes back on the main list: Income tax return first, then the dog vaccines with the later date, and the pill still says “🌿 Level 2”. The change you made with no internet was kept.

steps.do: Tap “📘 How” next to “Income tax return”.
steps.see: A panel “HOW I DO THIS — Income tax return” opens with four steps to tick (the first is “Gather W-2s, 1099s, K-1s into one folder”) and a “📝 My notes” box.

steps.do: Tap the first step, “Gather W-2s, 1099s, K-1s into one folder”.
steps.see: Its box gets a tick ✓.

steps.do: Tap the “📝 My notes” box and type this example (with the apostrophes).
steps.type: Margaret O'Brien at the tax office has last year's folder (example)
steps.see: Your note reads exactly as typed, apostrophes and all.

steps.do: Tap the dim strip at the very top of the screen to close the panel, then tap “📘 How” next to Income tax return again.
steps.see: The panel opens again with your tick on the first step and your O'Brien note still in the box. Tap the dim strip at the top once more to close it.
steps.tip: The panel’s own close button sits under the purple test-copy bar, so use the dim strip at the top.
